column1: # LBCH-2026-001 verification witness — THREE-WAY per-vector sigCheck record, post-fix.
# Re-measurement of the CHECKMULTISIG Schnorr billing fix (commit 06cc3a3) against BOTH reference
# engines. Supersedes nothing; it ADDS the BCHN (consensus) leg that the fix-time artifact
# LBCH-2026-001-fix-deltas.tsv lacked, which is what left the soundness direction unclosed.
#   bchn    = legs/bchn/bchn-leg of bch-conformance, linking BCHN's own script engine built from
#             createVirtualMachineBch2026(); verify() for the verdict, evaluate().metrics for counts
#   corpus  = vmb_tests, the 11 signature families, 5,803 vectors, 4,467 metric-comparable.
#             Read from bchd-src/txscript/data/vmb_tests @ 1c26e26; all 18 family files are
# DRIVER VALIDATION (done BEFORE any use): the libauth driver reproduces the committed witness
#   opCost 30962). The costprobe run reproduces all 1,486 rows of LBCH-2026-001-fix-deltas.tsv on
#   three independent columns (sigChecksAfter, libauthSigChecks, opCostAfter) with 0 mismatches.
# sigBefore is the pre-fix LeanBCH count, reconstructed from the committed fix-deltas artifact
# (which lists every vector that MOVED); vectors absent from it did not move, so before == after.
# HEADLINE — sigChecks, over the 4467 metric-comparable vectors:
# SOUNDNESS DIRECTION (LeanBCH billing LESS than consensus):
#   324 vectors bill under BCHN. ALL of them are vectors LeanBCH REJECTS
#   (leanVerdict=0) and BCHN accepts; 0 of them are new (the fix introduced none).
#   On the 1817 vectors LeanBCH ACCEPTS: under=0, agree=1547, over=270
#   — an under-bill on an accepted input is the only way a cost defect can cause a wrong ACCEPT,
#   and there are none, before or after the fix.
#   Cause of the 324: all are core.signing-serialization Schnorr-multisig vectors whose
#   locking script carries FOUR signature ops; LeanBCH errors at the first CHECKMULTISIG with a
#   non-empty dummy (the deferred branch, LeanBCH/VM/Extended.lean:228) and never executes -- hence
#   never bills -- the remaining three. Deferral of EXECUTION, not a billing error.
# MULTISIG PARTITION (the families named *.multisig.*): comparable=1367, verdict-agreeing-with-libauth=1155
#   The historical "2,617 verdict-agreeing multisig vectors / 1,255 / 1,360 / 2" is NOT reproducible:
#   the multisig families supply only 1908 vectors in total (1367 comparable), and a search over 11
#   candidate partitions x {libauth,bchn} x {before,after} found NO combination yielding that triple.
#   Its "under = 2" column DOES reproduce exactly: 0u4tu8 and g8xdap, both m-of-15, both LeanBCH 0 /
#   libauth 1 / BCHN 0 -- i.e. LeanBCH matches CONSENSUS and libauth is the outlier (LBCH-2026-003).
# columns: sigBefore/sigAfter = LeanBCH pre/post fix; sigLibauth, sigBchn = reference engines.
# leanVerdict: 1=accept 0=reject. bchnOutcome: BCHN's accept/reject. expected: corpus polarity.
